title: US tightens chip export controls to China
body: BIS rule restricting advanced-node chip exports raises the strategic value of SE Asian AI hubs as neutral compute geography.

title: AWS launches Malaysia Region
body: AWS announces $6B Malaysia investment by 2038, anchoring Greater KL as a regional cloud hub.

title: Blackstone-backed Bridge DC expands Sedenak
body: Phase 2 of the Sedenak campus breaks ground, doubling capacity.

title: BIS updates export rules (covered countries)
body: Tighter restrictions tighten incentives for compute capacity outside China-adjacent jurisdictions.

title: YTL announces 500 MW Kulai AI park
body: NVIDIA partnership announced as anchor tenant for AI training cluster.

title: Microsoft commits $2.2B to Malaysia
body: Satya Nadella announces a multi-region buildout across Greater KL and Johor.

title: Google commits ~$2B to Malaysia
body: First Google data center and cloud region announced in Elmina, Selangor.

title: Malaysia National Energy Transition Roadmap update
body: MOF/MITI signal accelerated renewable PPA pathways for data center operators.

title: Blackstone closes AirTrunk acquisition
body: ~A$24B platform deal locks up significant Johor capacity under PE ownership.

title: Oracle commits ~$6.5B to Malaysia
body: Oracle announces multiple cloud regions across Johor and Cyberjaya.

title: TNB tariff rebalancing consultation
body: Industry consultation begins on data-center-specific tariff structure to manage grid load.

title: US AI Diffusion framework proposed
body: Proposed rules categorize countries by compute access tier; Malaysia's tier status influences hyperscaler siting.

title: Johor-Singapore SEZ formalized
body: Special Economic Zone agreement signed, lowering cross-border friction for the data center belt.

title: Water-use cap proposed for Johor data centers
body: Johor state introduces consultation on water consumption caps for new builds.
